_doc: ADMIT-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): "everything has to work together automatically and seamlessly from the beginning ... it has to all bootstrap autonomously." One row in doctrine/tenant-repos.json admits a tenant; every registry below is derived from that row, the tenant's instance.json and its doctrine/topology.json worker by foundation/admit.py, so the checks that enumerate tenants from these registries (progress, tenantpromo, fullstack, stickiness, clock, cost guard) see every live tenant. Read by foundation/admit.py: `admit --check` in checks, `admit --apply` in scripts/regen_generated.py on every merge.

registries.why: visible progress, stall repair and stickiness (PROGRESS-1, STICKY-1); the root registry the other tenant checks read
the core publisher drains the tenant's social queue
repository settings and visibility are applied by org-settings.yml (REPO-SETTINGS-1, DISCOVER-1)
ultrastable.io and every sibling link to it (DISCOVER-1)
its beat is a clock; a stopped beat is a defect (CLOCKWORK-1)
its D1 reads are sampled hourly against its own budget (TENANT-SANDBOX-1)
